services.name: Outdoor Exhibits
services.desc: Miami Children's Museum has been creating experiences to meet the needs of all children in our multicultural community over the past 32 years. A birthday party at MiChiMu gives your child and guests a private area and endless play! Being a Member at Miami Children’s Museum means that you can get access to special events and experiences, see traveling exhibits before they open to the public, enjoy special pricing on birthday parties and camps, enjoy additional events hosted by our partners, and so much more! The Early Childhood Institute is a licensed and accredited preschool located inside the Museum that features intimate classroom sizes with smaller teacher-student
